caption: The drawing features three views of garments that appear to be parts of a matching outfit made from a cream-colored fabric patterned with small, scattered floral motifs in blue, pink, and green. On the right side, there is a full-length dress with a flared skirt, sleeveless bodice, and V-neckline, trimmed with red edging around the neck, armholes, and waist, and decorated with a row of red buttons on the front bodice. On the upper left, there is a long-sleeved, fitted jacket or bodice with similar floral fabric, black trimming on the edges, and black horizontal stripes with buttons running down the front. The sleeves are slightly flared at the wrists. On the lower left, the back view of the same jacket or bodice is shown, highlighting the seam details, the fitted waist, peplum-like flares at the back, and buttons on the lower back near the waist. The composition lays out the front and back of the jacket/bodice and the front of the dress on a plain, light, unadorned background.
title: Dress
